title: macOS jobs wait 35 to 80 minutes for a runner; measure the wait and name the cause
why: Every lane lint and main's own green read wait on a macOS job, so merges stall on a queue nobody has measured. Sample 04:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:57, from the run record, n=1): duo-ui run 43580457590 sat queued 09:25Z to 10:17Z = 52 min for a macOS runner.
source: Coordinator 16:39 CST Nov 13: runner 10's REST read at 16:38 CST; unchecked by triage.
note: Filed 16:39 CST Nov 13 (the coordinator asked for it as its own step, express). Evidence (runner 10's read, unchecked by triage): 11 lane-touched-tests runs queued, the oldest since 16:03 CST; main's run 43509070895 (59da758a3) queued since 15:15 CST with its macOS job unfinished; waits 35 to 80 minutes. Done check: a measured queue wait per macOS job from runs already kept (created_at to started_at, no new logging), and a named cause: hosted capacity, a concurrency limit, or an outage. First cut: CI-speed PR #3282, a macOS leg only for macOS-subject files. Relations: ci-mac-once-per-batch, claude-settings #2970 (ci-batch-mac-runner; with the owner's Mac offline it needs a hosted fallback), item 775 (#3259 waits on this queue). Past rulings not checked. Not started; the coordinator picks the lane. Coordinator 19:54 CST Nov 13 (19:53, owner asked it to start the lanes): lane started, session_013NEJL2mhNYPa64WtmkZCT8 (Sonnet, medium; searches for duplicates first). Measure only. Lane 20:01 CST Nov 13 (19:59, via the coordinator; measure only, built nothing). REST, 910 runs, 11:26-19:51 CST Nov 13, 575 macOS job rows. Cause shown: a cap of 5 macOS jobs at once; 11 checks runs made 42 macOS jobs 14:30-15:30 and used 90% of the 15:00-17:30 slots; checks jobs waited 67-77 min median there, 0-2 min after 17:30. Unknown: the account's stated limit, other repos' load, any GitHub incident. Lane recommends A: land #3302 (macOS once per batch; in flight under CI-speed cuts, head 723e54e9787e, lane ci-speed-stack-4). B, hosted fallback #2970, needs billing, unmeasured; asked of the owner only if he wants it. Scratch: the lane's scratchpad (session_013NEJL2mhNYPa64WtmkZCT8).
